scenario.title: Test 11: Out-of-Order Multi-Slot Information Capture
dialogue: It's a residential house worth about 1.1 crore, jointly owned with my brother.
Yes, the original title deeds are available with me.
I am self-employed architect and receive fees through bank transfers.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Kavita Reddy, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Kavita Reddy?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: It's a residential house worth about 1.1 crore, jointly owned with my brother.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, the original title deeds are available with me.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you share whether you are salaried or self-employed, and whether your income is received through bank deposit or in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I am self-employed architect and receive fees through bank transfers.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: What repayment tenure would you prefer for this loan, between 3 to 15 years?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Congratulations Kavita Reddy! Based on the preliminary details provided, you meet all the eligibility criteria for our pre-approved Loan Against Property offer. I am now transferring your application to our Senior Loan Expert, who will contact you shortly to share the exact interest rates, customized EMI plans, and assist you with the fast-track paperwork. Thank you for choosing Home Credit, and have a wonderful day!
